text:
alex: Heads up — we're scheduling a soft-cycle (fan spindle + NIC microcode) across the satellite racks in eu-west1 next Tue during the low-traffic window. Plan is a rolling reboot across 10 racks, ~2min drain per node, cohorts of ~5 nodes at a time. Need coverage plan and customer comms.

maria: Do we have visibility on which Dedicated pools and spot backfills will be impacted? Any long-running batch jobs to reschedule?

jin: Proposal: stagger cohorts by AZ and shift low-priority spot work to on-demand for the window. Pre-warm KV caches after each cohort. Autoscale burst to absorb ~20% capacity hit. Cordon/drain command we plan to run:

```
kubectl cordon <node-name>
kubectl drain <node-name> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=10m
```

this keeps job eviction graceful and frees GPUs quickly.

tess: We need a short customer note + statuspage blurb. Also flag any SLOs we might breach; schedule for post-maint sanity check. @maria can you own customer comms? :calendar:

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: maintenance/1735507300 (ops-runbook: https://internal.runbooks/rack-softcycle). Reminder +30m and +10m before start.

alex: Quick back-of-envelope on cost: if we divert 10% of steady traffic to on-demand for 2 hours -> extra ~30 GPU-hours. At $6/GPU-hr that's ~ $180. If autoscale bursts to 20% it's ~60 GPU-hrs -> ~$360. So recommend covering up to $400 contingency.

maria: Can we confirm which model-serving routes are pinned to those racks? We should whitelist critical routes from being scheduled on the cohort nodes during the window.

jin: Good call. Add a temporary placement rule: route.priority=critical -> avoid labels rack=cohort-A until +1h post-restart. Revert command:

```
redwoodctl routing update --policy revert-to-default --selector "rack=cohort-A"
```

sre-oncall: FYI last night's az latency spike in eu-west1 suggests we should start at 03:00 UTC instead of 02:00 to avoid overlapping backups. Also: reduce cohort size to 3 nodes if we keep the earlier slot.

alex: Ack. Updated schedule to 03:00 UTC, cohorts of 3 nodes, will update the runbook and statuspage. @tess / @maria please publish the customer note and set the incident template to maintenance-mode. :thumbsup:

maria: Will publish and ping product mailing list. I'll include recovery ETA and contact for enterprise support.

jin: I'll run a canary pre-seed job to warm KV and model caches 15m before each cohort. Command to trigger priming payload:

```
redwoodctl jobs run --job priming --payload '{"seed_prompts": ["<warmup prompt>"]}' --region eu-west1
```

leaving traces and metric tags: maint_tag=softcycle-1735507300.

sre-oncall: I'll monitor latency and tail-p99 during the first cohort; if p99 > 250ms for more than 3m we abort and fallback.

alex: Thanks all — I'll post the finalized window and checklist in #eng-infra and schedule the +30/+10 reminders.
